subject: An ARRAY argument to the UNIVERSAL built-ins is not flattened: `$self->SUPER::isa(@_)` / `UNIVERSAL::isa($x, @a)` answer FALSE (silently) and `UNIVERSAL::isa(@two)` dies "invalid number of arguments: 1" -- the next Type::Tiny load blocker (Type::Tiny::isa is `$self->SUPER::isa(@_)`, so Types::Standard dies "Parent must be an instance of Type::Tiny")
